title: ⚡ Add Animations
content: Add smooth micro-interactions throughout. Buttons: hover:scale-105 or active:scale-95 with duration-200. Cards: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all. Links: animated underline on hover. Loading: animate-spin for spinners, animate-pulse for skeletons. Page transitions: fade-in with opacity transition. Scroll animations: elements fade-in as they enter viewport. Icon interactions: subtle rotation or bounce. Use duration-200 to duration-300 for snappy feel. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

variants.simple: Add smooth animations and hover effects to interactive elements.
variants.detailed: Add smooth micro-interactions throughout. Buttons: hover:scale-105 or active:scale-95 with duration-200. Cards: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all. Links: animated underline on hover. Loading: animate-spin for spinners, animate-pulse for skeletons. Page transitions: fade-in with opacity transition. Scroll animations: elements fade-in as they enter viewport. Icon interactions: subtle rotation or bounce. Use duration-200 to duration-300 for snappy feel. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
variants.advanced: Add smooth micro-interactions throughout the interface. Button animations: hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150, or hover:bg-opacity-90 for subtle effect. Card interactions: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200, add group class for child animations (group-hover:text-blue-600). Link underlines: relative after:absolute after:bottom-0 after:left-0 after:h-0.5 after:w-0 after:bg-current hover:after:w-full after:transition-all. Loading states: animate-spin for Loader2 icon, animate-pulse for skeleton screens, animate-bounce for attention. Entrance animations: use Intersection Observer for scroll-triggered fade-in, opacity-0 translate-y-4 -> opacity-100 translate-y-0 transition-all duration-500. Stagger children: delay-75, delay-150, delay-225 for sequential reveals. Icon micro-interactions: hover:rotate-12 for settings, group-hover:translate-x-1 for arrows. Modal/dropdown: animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 (using tailwindcss-animate). Duration guide: 150ms for hovers, 200-300ms for transitions, 300-500ms for page animations. CRITICAL: wrap in motion-safe: or check prefers-reduced-motion to respect user preferences.
